nodes.label: SecurityScopedBookmarkManager
nodes.rationale: Uses security-scoped bookmarks to persist folder permissions across application launches under macOS Sandbox.

nodes.label: SQLiteDatabase
nodes.rationale: Enables high concurrency and faster writes via Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) and synchronous normal mode.

nodes.label: ACDSee Culling Shortcuts
nodes.rationale: Provides a keyboard-driven workflow for professional photographers to cull photos efficiently using star ratings, tag flags, and quick arrow key navigation.

nodes.label: Zero-Import Architecture
nodes.rationale: Avoids slow photo importing process by accessing files directly through macOS Security-Scoped Bookmarks and FSEvents directory monitoring.

nodes.label: Three-Layer Caching Strategy
nodes.rationale: Optimizes performance via: 1) NSCache memory cache for current and preloaded thumbnails, 2) SQLite disk cache for EXIF metadata, and 3) File system for original high-resolution or RAW files.

nodes.label: Look-Ahead Prefetching Engine
nodes.rationale: Asynchronously loads metadata and thumbnails for adjacent files (N-2, N-1, N+1, N+2) in the background to enable smooth, lag-free culling transitions.

nodes.label: Metal Image Rendering
nodes.rationale: Uses Core Image and Metal to hardware-accelerate image scaling and rendering, maintaining a smooth 120 FPS frame rate on ProMotion screens.
